AWAKEN ("the app") is developed by Assis Mohanty, Hyderabad, India. Contact: assis.mohanty.98@gmail.com.
What the app stores: your hunter profile, quests, habits, progress and settings are stored only on your device. The app has no account system. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

AI Paths (optional): if you turn on AI Paths, the app sends the following to our server, which forwards it to our AI provider, Cloudflare (Workers AI), to write your Path quests: your Path goal, current level and notes as you typed them; your chosen stats, active days and weekly time; your equipment and injury settings; and the titles, outcomes and "too easy / right / too hard" feedback of last week\'s Path quests. It does not send your name, health data, XP, level or any account information. Requests are checked with Google Play Integrity and identified only by a random install ID. Our server does not store the content of requests or responses; it keeps a one-way hash of the install ID with request counts for 30 days to prevent abuse. Cloudflare states that Workers AI follows a zero data retention commitment: for standard inference requests, inputs and outputs are not retained after the response is delivered, and Cloudflare does not use them to train AI models. It does retain operational metadata such as timestamps, token counts and error codes, but not the content of requests or responses. (Source: Cloudflare Workers AI data usage documentation.) Rewards (XP, gold, levels) are always calculated on your device by fixed rules, never by the AI. You can turn AI Paths off anytime in Settings; existing Paths stay on your device.

Reports: if you report a quest, its text and your chosen reason are sent and kept for up to 90 days to improve safety. Reports contain no identifier, so we cannot look up or delete a specific user\'s report.

Health Connect: if you choose to enable verified quests, the app reads Steps, Exercise sessions and Sleep sessions from Health Connect on your device to mark matching quests complete. If you also allow them, it reads Distance, Active calories and Heart rate to complete distance and calorie quests and to show your activity inside the app. Data entered by hand in a health app is ignored. This data is processed on-device only, is never uploaded (including to AI Paths), and is not used for advertising. You can revoke access anytime in Health Connect settings. Use of information received from Health Connect adheres to the Health Connect Permissions policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Phone step counter (optional): if no app shares steps with Health Connect and you tap \"Count steps on this phone\", the app asks for the Physical activity permission and uses Google\'s Recording API, part of Google Play services, to count steps with your phone\'s own sensors. The step totals stay on your device (Google Play services keeps up to 10 days of them), are shown on the Health screen and used to complete step quests when no other app shares steps, are never uploaded by the app (including to AI Paths), do not need a Google account, and are not used for advertising. You can turn it off anytime by removing the Physical activity permission in your phone\'s settings.

Insights and recaps: the app also uses this data, on your device only, to show you personal patterns (for example, how many quests you complete on days after 7+ hours of sleep or with 7,000+ steps) and monthly and yearly summaries of your own activity. To cover past months it keeps daily totals (steps, sleep time, distance) in the app\'s local database. These patterns describe correlations in your own data; they are not medical advice. Nothing is uploaded, shared, sent to AI Paths, or used for advertising. Weekly reviews (what went well, what slipped, your intention) and your chosen identities are stored only on your device and included in your export file.

Screen time: if you allow usage access, the app reads how long each app was in the foreground on your device to show your screen time and to check the daily limits you set for Screen Discipline. It also reads the list of apps you can open from your launcher, to show their names. This data stays on your device, is never uploaded (including to AI Paths), and is not used for advertising. You can turn usage access off anytime in your phone\'s settings.

Backups: Android may include app data in your Google account device backup according to your phone\'s backup settings. You can export or delete all data from Settings → Your data. Uninstalling the app deletes its data from the device.
Children: the app is not directed to children under 13.
Changes: we will update this page and the effective date if this policy changes.
